response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId), cc AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS avg_round FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), ct AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.avg_round, cc.avg_round - ct.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN ct ON ct.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Country baseline is the average round over all races (not circuits) in that country, so circuits with more races weigh more, as the request states.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily since no tiebreaker was specified.
